FPT Software Company Limited () is a global IT services provider headquartered in Hanoi, Vietnam, being the core subsidiary of the FPT Corporation. As of 2024, the company reached US$2.47 billion in revenue and more than 54,000 core employees across 30 countries.
History
FPT Software was founded in 1999 by 13 members of FPT Group, led by Nguyen Thanh Nam (later CEO, Chairman of FPT Software then CEO of FPT Corporation until 2011).
In 2005, FPT Software opened its first overseas branch in Japan, and in 2007 the company opened an office in Singapore and exceeded US$10 million in profits.
In 2008 the company expanded global operations to France, and in 2012 it opened its first office in Germany.
In 2014, FPT Software acquired RWE IT Slovakia, becoming the first Vietnamese IT company to conduct an overseas merger and acquisition.
In 2016, FPT Korea was established and FPT Software reached US$200 million of revenue and 10,000 employees, with FPT Japan becoming FPT Software's first overseas branch to surpass US$100 million in revenue.
In 2017, FPT Software partnered with 75 companies in the Fortune Global 500 and signed a contract worth over USD$35 million for enterprise resource planning (ERP) development.
In 2018, FPT bought a majority stake in Intellinet, a US-based consulting firm, and was listed among top 40 IT companies in Japan.
In 2021, FPT reached US$500 million in revenue, with 50% growth in the US market, and during the pandemic the company continued its global office expansion and maintained growth in revenue and profits.
In 2022, FPT Software reported revenue over US$800 million, marking the third consecutive year of revenue growth above 25%. The company began working with customers generating over US$100 million in annual revenue and opened its 10th U.S. office in New York City.
In 2023, FPT Software conducted mergers, acquisitions and investments in the United States and Europe, and joined the AI Alliance. The company was named a Regional Strategic Services Partner by SAP in the Asia Pacific and Japan region. In December FPT Automotive, a unit focused on software-defined vehicles, was established. In the same year, FPT Software reported over US$1 billion in revenue from global IT services.
In 2024, the company reported revenue of US$2.47 billion and profit before tax of US$434.57 million. It received a Silver Rating from EcoVadis for its sustainability practices and was deemed as a Great Place to Work® in multiple countries. The same year FPT Corporation established 2 AI Factories in Vietnam and Japan, leveraging NVIDIA's advanced GPU technology.
In 2025, FPT received the EcoVadis Silver Rating for Sustainability Excellence through its Japanese subsidiary, and received the SAP APJ Partner Excellence Award 2025 for Regional Strategic Services Partner. FPT and Chelsea Football Club announced a strategic global partnership, in which FPT will provide AI-driven and digital solutions to support Chelsea’s operations and fan engagement.
Services
FPT Software’s services include:
* Vertical Industries: Automotive, Healthcare, Insurance.
* Digital Technologies & Platforms: Low-code, Digital Commerce & Experience, Cloud, Data & Analytics, Hyperautomation.
* Product Engineering Services: PLM/ALM, Automotive services & solutions.
* IT Services: S/4HANA, Dynamics 365, Mainframe Migration, ERP Modernization.
The company caters to various industries: Utilities & Energy, BFSI, Media & Entertainment, Logistics & Transportation, to Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, and Aviation & Aerospace.
